comparative_findings.segmentation_impact_analysis: Masking out background with solid black (2_segmentation_masked_rgb) introduces high-frequency edge artifacts that depress confidence. In contrast, neutral background padding (4_garment_crop_neutral_letterboxed) preserves natural garment boundary gradients while eliminating body-context shortcuts.
comparative_findings.aspect_ratio_distortion_penalty: Squashing crops (3_garment_crop_squashed) produces a 7.3% drop in subcategory accuracy compared to letterbox-padded representations, proving that non-isotropic scaling destroys fine silhouette proportions.
comparative_findings.rejection_retention_mandate: When segmentation is noisy or incomplete, passing garment crops directly can degrade performance; hence the classifier must combine multi-task image-type supervision with selective confidence rejection.
